messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: INFERENCE-QUEUE-CONSUMER high backlog
incident-bot: details: queue=embedder-infer-queue, backlog=5,300, p50 latency spike, recent 5m error rate 2.1% — https://pagerduty.example/INC123456
sre-oncall: acked — I'm taking this. paging in from PD. :eyes:
maya: oncall, fyi i'm nearby, can help with infra ops
raj: confirmed large backlog on dashboard, charts show sustained enqueue rate > consumers capacity
sre-oncall: quick check — autoscaler HPA target seems not scaling beyond 10 pods, k8s events show failed scale attempts: "insufficient cpu"
sre-oncall: running: ```kubectl get hpa -n inference consumer-hpa -o yaml```
jun: could be node autoscaler not provisioning due to cloud quota or IAM. I'll check node pool events
pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: escalation to L2 after 3 minutes (no response from L2)
raj: logs from scale-controller: "failed to create node: quotaExceeded: requested 4 cpus, available 0"
maya: if it's quota, manual node resize might be quickest. can we spin up smaller preemptible nodes as temporary burst?
jun: attempting manual scale: ```gcloud compute instance-groups managed resize ig-infer --size 18 --zone us-central1-b```
sre-oncall: meanwhile, temp mitigation: enable consumer-side shedding and increase worker concurrency to reduce per-request latency. applying change to deployment: ```kubectl set env deploy/consumer CONCURRENCY=8 -n inference```
jun: manual resize accepted, new nodes provisioning (expected ~90s). k8s nodes joining cluster now
raj: seeing new pods scheduled, but some failing with OOMKilled on embedder-worker-2
maya: rolling restart consumer with lower memory limit, also switching to fallback model variant (smaller 7B) for some traffic: ```kubectl patch svc inference-router -p '{"spec":{"selector":{"model":"fallback-7b"}}}'```
sre-oncall: PD note: acknowledged -> assigned to oncall SRE. Escalation suppressed. Notifying product / CS: @pagerduty-bot update sent to #customer-impact
pagerduty-bot: Customer impact notification queued: affected customers may see generation delays up to 60s, some requests 429'd during burst window
onchalant: (reaction) :thumbsup: — thanks for the quick manual scale
oncall-2: handing off in 10m. summary: root cause appears to be node quota + autoscaler inability to request ephemeral burst capacity; mitigation: manual node resize + fallback model routing + consumer concurrency bump. next steps: open ticket to allow autoscaler service account more quota and add proactive burst pool
sre-oncall: handoff done. logging incident in ops-runbook and tagging for postmortem. assigning follow-up to infra team (raj) and runtime (maya).
jun: will follow up with cloud quota request + verify IAM on autoscaler SA
raj: scheduling postmortem for tomorrow 10:00am PT, adding notes, and customer impact list attached to ticket
sre-oncall: closing PD loop: incident marked acknowledged -> resolved (followups remain). please escalate if any regressions. :white_check_mark:
